## About Rohan Chougule
Rohan Chougule is a solution architect with over 17 years of experience in building scalable, high-traffic web and mobile applications. He specializes in frontend, backend, cloud, and DevOps solutions, emphasizing performance and clean architecture. Rohan has founded three startups and leads engineering teams to deliver reliable products. His current focus is on pioneering AI-driven systems, workflow automation, and scaling modern SaaS infrastructures.
